svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: As the base beam: two UPN 160 channels 840 mm, webs 104 mm apart,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 mm end blocks, joint holes 18 mm at 272 and 328 mm each side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 and 110 mm up from the beam bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Doublers: 12 x 200 x 139 mm plate, one on the outside of each web, in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the middle, 6 mm fillet weld all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin bore: 62 mm through both webs and doublers, 80 mm up (mid-height).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp the channels together and cut both with a 62 mm annular cutter

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (hired magnetic drill); weld the end blocks with a 60 mm bar through.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bracket holes: four 14 mm in the top flanges, 40 mm each side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle, 100 mm each side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guides (UHMW-PE): two blocks 29 x 104 x 160 mm, 46 to 75 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the middle; two 6 x 92 x 139 mm strips on the webs with 62 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes on the pin. Two M6 countersunk screws each, through the web.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the stem slides between the guides with 1 mm each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 60 mm bar slides through both bores by hand.
